sentences.text:
This is first application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail to the applicant, who has been arrested on 21.06.2023, in connection with Crime No.436/2023, for offence under Sections 376(3), 376(2n), 294 and 506 of IPC and Sections 3/4 and 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act,
registered at Police Station-Gorakhpur, District-Jabalpur (M.P.).
2.
Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that applicant is a young boy aged about 19 years.
He was in love affair with prosecutrix and has falsely been implicated in the case of rape.
There is delay in lodging of FIR.
In these circumstances, counsel for applicant prays for grant of bail to the applicant.

sentences.text: 3. Learned Government Advocate appearing for the State as well as counsel appearing for the objector opposed the application for grant of bail.
It is submitted that applicant was emotionally blackmailing the prosecutrix.

In these circumstances,
application for grant of bail may be dismissed.
4. Heard the counsel for the parties.

5 . Considering 164 statement given by prosecutrix and the age of applicant, bail application filed by applicant is allowed on following conditions :
1. Applicant will not try to contact the prosecutrix, her family members and acquaintances in any manner.

If applicant will approach the prosecutrix in any way and complaint is filed before trial Court, then after examining the prosecutrix if complaint is found to be true then trial Court is at liberty to send the applicant to jail and discharge his bail bonds and surety.

2. Applicant will regularly appear before the trial Court on all dates, and in exceptional circumstances can file application for exemption giving reasons before the Court and Court shall consider the same on its merits.

6. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on furnishing personal bond of Rs. 50,000/-(Rs.
Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety and security in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court.

application for grant of bail may be dismissed.
5 . Considering 164 statement given by prosecutrix and the age of applicant, bail application filed by applicant is allowed on following conditions :
1. Applicant will not try to contact the prosecutrix, her family members and acquaintances in any manner.

7. The applicant shall also abide by the following conditions of Section 437 (3) of Cr. P. C. as under:-
(a) that such person shall attend in accordance with the conditions of the bond executed under this Chapter;
(b) that such person shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused, or suspected of the commission of which he is suspected and;
(c) that such person shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
8. C.C. as per rules.
